items.headline: Anthropic's Revenue Run Rate Just Hit $65 Billion, With a Fall IPO Taking Shape
items.summary: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate (what it would earn in a year at its current pace) topped $65 billion by the end of July, up from $47 billion in May. Investment banks including Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan are reportedly lining up to take the company public as soon as this fall at a valuation north of $2 trillion.
items.why_it_matters: When the company behind Claude keeps growing this fast and is headed toward Wall Street, it's a strong sign Claude isn't a fly-by-night tool you should worry about disappearing, useful reassurance if you're building your workflow around it long-term.

items.headline: Claude Code's Extra Weekly Capacity Runs Out Tomorrow
items.summary: Anthropic's temporary 50% boost to Claude Code's weekly usage limits, which it has renewed several times since May, is set to expire August 19 for Pro, Max, Team, and legacy seat-based Enterprise plans, unless Anthropic quietly extends it again at the last minute like it has before.
items.why_it_matters: If you use Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant) for scripting, automations, or other build-it-yourself projects, your weekly capacity could shrink by roughly a third starting tomorrow, so it's worth wrapping up or kicking off any bigger jobs today.

opportunity.action_note: If you lean on Claude Code, use up any big weekly-limit-heavy tasks today (August 18) before the 50% usage boost is set to expire tomorrow, August 19.
